decision.title: tree-sitter's WebAssembly language files in the JavaScript package (packet )

body.p: , after , , , , , . Carries out what delayed as (a); the owner's order: the book (a24417c), the tests (ef6af16), the implementation (913f60b). 's "Delayed (a)" is done by this record; (b), the native wasm store, stays rejected and (c), Kotlin and Swift, waits for 6.12 (the host shim now passes languages, below).

item.p: The files (glossary , ): tree-sitter 0.27's tree-sitter build --wasm runs the WASI SDK's clang: --target=wasm32-wasip1 -fPIC -shared --no-wasm-opt -Os -Wl,--export=tree_sitter_NAME -Wl,--allow-undefined -Wl,--no-entry -nostdlib -fno-exceptions -fvisibility=hidden over parser.c and scanner.c (read from its verbose output). The result is a side module of the tool conventions' dynamic linking: a dylink.0 section (memory size and alignment, table size and alignment, needed libraries); imports env.memory, env.__indirect_function_table, env.__memory_base, env.__table_base, often env.__stack_pointer, and the C functions its scanner calls; exports tree_sitter_NAME and __wasm_apply_data_relocs. Measured on the eleven vendored grammars: JSON, Go and C import no functions; Python malloc, calloc, realloc, free; JavaScript, TypeScript and CSS iswspace, iswalpha, iswalnum; HTML and Markdown also towupper, towlower, strlen, strcmp, strncpy, memcmp and __assert_fail. tree-sitter's own loader (lib/src/wasm_store.c) reads the same files and allows the functions of lib/src/wasm-stdlib/imports.txt (25: calloc, free, malloc, realloc, the mem/str subset, isw*, towlower, towupper) plus abort, __assert_fail and a few WASI no-ops; web-tree-sitter (emscripten's loader) reads them too.

sxml.wasm (bindings/javascript/CMakeLists.txt): links with --export-table --growable-table --export=__stack_pointer and --export= each function of imports.txt, read from the vendored file at configure time (one list). The module's memory was exported already. So a side module shares sxml.wasm's memory, heap (sxml's malloc), function table and shadow stack; sxml's tree-sitter calls the grammar's lexer and scanner through the table as it calls a compiled-in grammar's, and the scanner calls sxml's lexer callbacks the same way. No PIC main module and no second runtime: the static module only exports what a side module imports.

The module linker (glossary , bindings/javascript/src/linker.ts): reads dylink.0 (WebAssembly.Module.customSections) and refuses a module without one, one with needed libraries, and one with any import outside env.memory, the table, the stack pointer, the two bases, abort and __assert_fail (JavaScript functions that throw a RuntimeError, as the wasm store's trap) and the functions sxml.wasm exports for scanners, naming every such import (GOT.mem/GOT.func imports of emscripten files with preemptible symbols, C++ runtime functions of old C++ scanners, and --reuse-allocator files' ts_current_* are refused this way); the error names the reason. It reserves the module's memory with sxml.wasm's malloc (aligned, zeroed for the bss), grows the table by its size after the last slot (aligned), instantiates with the bases, runs __wasm_apply_data_relocs, __wasm_call_ctors and _initialize when exported, and calls tree_sitter_NAME (NAME the host's name with - made _, else the module's only tree_sitter_* export). Nothing is ever released: an instance cannot be unloaded while the table holds its functions.

Registration: the host shim's sxml_host_processor_configuration gains source_code_languages (appended; zero is none; passed to sxml_processor_configuration). The JavaScript shim: sxml_javascript_processor_create takes a third argument, a sxml_source_code_language_view * (NULL none), and sxml_javascript_check_code_language exports sxml_source_code_check_language; the shim static-asserts the wasm32 layout the package writes (44-byte language, 8-byte view, 12-byte report). Swift's memberwise initializer names the new field (not compiled here: no Swift toolchain); Kotlin's designated initializer needs nothing. No public header changes.

API (src/index.ts): Sxml.loadCodeLanguage({ wasm, name, highlights, locals, injections, injectionRegex }) returns a CodeLanguage (name, abiVersion) after the shim's check, whose problems become an Error worded as the sxml command words them ("the grammar's ABI is 12; sxml reads 13 to 15", "the highlights query does not fit the grammar at byte 1", a bad name); wasm is any WasmSource, as for load(). createProcessor({ codeLanguages }) copies the languages into a view made with malloc, freed with the processor; a language of another Sxml or two of one name throw. A language and its texts live as long as its Sxml, so processor leak counts stay 0. The package now binds the prefix sxml to urn:sxml wherever the source-code feature is present, as the sxml command does ().
Not supported: emscripten's older dylink section (before dylink.0, 2021); files that need other side modules; scanner imports outside the list above.

Tests: javascript/code_languages builds JSON, Python and CSS from the vendored grammars with tree-sitter's command line above (custom commands, the wasm preset's compiler, no network) and checks that the loaded Python and CSS give the built-in grammars' documents exactly, highlights included, JSON's highlights and names, several processors per language, and the refusals on modules made byte by byte (no dylink.0, a needed library, env.fopen, no tree_sitter_NAME, ABI 12) and of a query, a name and another module's language: 12 of 12. javascript/package and javascript/languages pass unchanged. The book's JavaScript chapter: 5 examples, all match (with WASI_SDK_PREFIX, which builds the JSON file).

Sizes: sxml.wasm 13,448,586 bytes stripped / 2,420,734 gzipped at this change (budget 14,000,000 / 2,800,000, not raised); its code and data grow by 7,713 bytes for this change (the linker map against the baseline: the libc functions exported for scanners 6,995, of them iswpunct's table 4,000, memmove 1,325, memcpy 1,031, memset 408; sxml_source_code_check 392 now reachable from an export; the shim 56; export data 270); the rest of the map's +22,892 since the baseline is other packets' (ixml_tokens, ixml_earley, XSLT). Baseline not refreshed. The CLI module is unchanged by this packet (15,041,890 / 2,704,138).
